profile.name: Ahmed Osama
profile.headline: Software Engineer building reliable systems and AI-powered web products.
profile.bio: At Microsoft, I work on Clarity's backend, deployments, and production reliability. I also build end-to-end products with React, TypeScript, and FastAPI, including LLM agents, MCP integrations, and open-source platforms.

openSource.name: MetaHarmonizerApp
openSource.program: Google Summer of Code 2026 | Product Engineer | May-Aug 2026
bullets: Built and deployed an end-to-end metadata-harmonization platform for cBioPortal, with a FastAPI backend and React dashboard.
Productionized the matching pipeline with arq workers, PostgreSQL, and Redis, including retries, timeouts, and cancellation.
Defined service-level objectives and enforced them with health checks, logging, Sentry, and request metrics.
Built Docker Compose deployments and CI/CD for smoke tests and database migrations, including air-gapped deployment support.
Hardened the API with rate limiting, idempotency, JWT/RBAC, and an append-only audit trail.
Architected a swappable engine-adapter layer over an ML matching pipeline, keeping the app decoupled and vendor-agnostic.
Shipped a standalone MCP server and collaborated directly with cBioPortal maintainers.
Served as DRI for Clarity's backend and deployments, supporting 2M+ websites.
Upgraded ClickHouse versions and migrated 40 PB of data.
Consolidated service metrics and alerts into one dashboard, replacing 30 separate resources and tabs; tuned 20+ production alerts.
Owned the screenshotting service used across Clarity sites and applications.
Optimized and migrated workloads across Azure regions and Kubernetes clusters, reducing regional memory and infrastructure usage by 10%.
Hardened the Clarity JS release pipeline to reduce release-related data loss.
Built Selenium and Playwright synthetic tests that replay real-user workflows to catch production regressions.
Built visual-parity checks with Python and Bash, and cross-release performance benchmarks for Clarity web apps.
Owned the software architecture of DORIAN, a human-in-the-loop intelligent discovery assistant.
Developed core components with Neo4j, Next.js, and FastAPI.
Designed hybrid session management using Redis and MongoDB.
Completed bachelor thesis research on modular Intelligent Discovery Assistant architectures.
Profiled & optimized background threads in Clarity SDK (Kotlin, Android).
Built PoC for transitioning from WorkManager to JobScheduler.
Identified & resolved 3 memory leaks via LeakCanary integration.
Implemented baseline profiles improving runtime performance by 30%.

notes: Specialized in Software Engineering, with a focus on systems design and full-stack development.
Graduated with a GPA of B+ across core computer science and engineering coursework.
Awarded a full scholarship covering all four years of study for outstanding high-school performance.
Completed bachelor thesis research on modular Intelligent Discovery Assistant architectures at DFKI.

projects.name: Threshold
bullets: Built an all-or-nothing pledge platform using PayPal: funds are held, then captured or voided at the deadline.
Signed every pledge with Ed25519 and built a public proof page that checks it against PayPal's own records.
Designed an AI assistant with signed spending limits enforced by the server, not the model.
Deployed on Render, Neon, and Cloudflare Pages; validated Orders, Payouts, and webhooks end to end in the PayPal sandbox with 1,300+ automated tests.

projects.name: Walk-in
bullets: Built an AI site-selection agent that analyzes a vacant storefront and designs a business the surrounding area is missing.
Tested recommendations against live Qloo data over real walking and driving areas, rejecting ideas that fail hard checks.
Evaluated recommendations across 15 storefronts in 15 cities: Walk-in produced 14 different business types, while a plain chatbot selected a cafe, coffee shop, or bakery at 10 locations.
Engineered a Gemini/Groq fallback chain, SSE streaming, and an MCP server, with 1,400+ tests in CI.

projects.name: DyeCast
bullets: Built a hair-dye forecast that predicts what a box dye will do to a user's hair and renders the result.
Implemented a deterministic color-chemistry engine using Delta E 2000 on both the server and browser.
Added on-device hair measurement and shade-code OCR; deleted photos from YouCam after delivery.
Secured the application with Google OAuth (PKCE), scrypt, and database-backed rate limits; deployed on Vercel with 276 tests.

projects.name: Personal Blog
bullets: Built a full-stack, serverless blog using React, Vite, and GitHub Pages.
Integrated Supabase as a Backend-as-a-Service for PostgreSQL database and admin authentication.
Implemented a secure admin CMS panel with Markdown rendering, drafts, and Row Level Security.
Engineered offline-mode support using localStorage with PBKDF2 hashed passwords and brute-force lockouts.

projects.name: pgwatch AI Copilot
bullets: Built a CLI AI copilot that answers natural-language questions about PostgreSQL metrics collected by pgwatch.
Implemented automatic metric discovery and anomaly detection, with deep analysis of locks, sessions, tables, and WAL.
Added natural-language Q&A and SQL generation through OpenAI or Ollama, using Go, pgx, and Cobra.
Supports deep metric inspection (db_stats, locks, sessions, WAL) with colored terminal output.

projects.name: E-commerce Platform
bullets: Implemented a scalable microservices architecture enabling independent deployment of services.
Integrated Apache Kafka for reliable asynchronous communication between services.
Designed and built a secure authentication & authorization system (JWT + role-based access).
Crafted a responsive Next.js frontend with dynamic product browsing and cart interactions.
Developed a robust Nest.js backend exposing REST APIs with validation & error handling.
Containerized all services with Docker to streamline local development & deployment.

projects.name: Staff Help Desk Application
bullets: Streamlined support and ticketing processes for agents and users.
Real-time notifications & chat using Socket.IO.
Knowledge base feature for self-service issue resolution.
MERN stack for scalability and responsiveness.

projects.name: Cairo Metro System
bullets: Web app for reserving & paying for metro tickets.
Upcoming travel views and ticket management.
Admin panel for stations, routes, modifications.
PostgreSQL for efficient data storage & retrieval.

projects.name: GIU Bachelor Portal
bullets: Constructed a portal for GIU students to browse available bachelor project opportunities.
Facilitated communication between professors and students via integrated messaging features.
Implemented server-side logic with ASP.NET and SQL for data persistence.
Designed a clean, accessible HTML/CSS interface for project discovery & interaction.

projects.name: Marvel-Wargame
bullets: Developed a two-player board game featuring team selection of 3 distinct Marvel characters.
Implemented unique character abilities and turn-based combat mechanics.
Applied Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles for characters, abilities, and game state.
Built an interactive GUI with Java Swing enabling engaging player experience.
